note: What a real operative report for laparoscopic cholecystectomy contains, merged from four sources, and whether SurgiDoc reports it. Categories are a judgement by the author from the system's design; for covered and partial items, `check` is tested against each run's actual claims by surgidoc.evals.checklist. de: section of the German template where it has one.

sources.DE: German operative report template, laparoscopic cholecystectomy, MIC-Manual der Endoskopischen Chirurgie (Kliniken Essen-Mitte, 2001; fictitious patient): http://www.mic-manual.de/ManualTestversion/MIC-Manual/MIC-KEM/Daten/pdf-s/Op-Berichte,etc/op-bericht-lap%20Galle.pdf
sources.RCSI: Royal College of Surgeons of Ireland criteria for operative notes, 14 items (corpus passage SYNOPTIC-2022-004)
sources.WSES: WSES 2020 bile duct injury guideline, minimum content of the operative report (corpus passages WSES-BDI-2020-074, -028, -029)
sources.DSS: Dutch Surgical Society 2006 key steps of laparoscopic cholecystectomy, as reported by Wauben et al. (corpus passage SYNOPTIC-2022-010)

categories.covered: SurgiDoc states it, from the video
categories.partial: SurgiDoc states a weaker version of it
categories.possible_from_video: visible in a full recording in principle; SurgiDoc does not report it (no model for it, or the CholecSeg8k fragments do not contain it)
categories.not_from_video: needs the patient record, the OR log or the surgeon; no video system can supply it

items.surgidoc: Not reported; the input is anonymous footage.

items.item: Date and time of the operation
items.surgidoc: Not reported. A hospital recording system could pass it in as metadata.
Not reported. A full recording gives start and end; CholecSeg8k has 10-25 s fragments only, and SurgiDoc's limitation claims say so (video55).
Not reported.

items.item: Diagnosis and indication, with ICD-10 code
items.surgidoc: Not reported. Findings in the video can support a diagnosis but not establish the indication.
Not reported. The procedure is known from the dataset, not detected; the code is a lookup that could be added to the header.

items.item: Access: incision, trocar insertion under vision, pneumoperitoneum
items.surgidoc: Not reported. Trocar insertion is visible from inside in a full recording; the pressure is not. Not in the test fragments.

items.item: Intraoperative findings: state of the gallbladder, inflammation, adhesions
items.surgidoc: Says which structures are visible (gallbladder, liver, fat ...), not their condition (distended, inflamed, adherent).
Not reported; needs action recognition (e.g. CholecT50 action triplets).
Reports the phase and when it occurs, as an estimate of a phase model without measured accuracy; not how it was done.

items.item: Critical view of safety: cystic duct and artery identified as the only two structures
items.de: Ductus cysticus und A. cystica zweifelsfrei identifiziert
items.surgidoc: Not assessed; every run hands it to the surgeon in a limitation claim. Needs a model trained on CVS labels (Endoscapes, Cholec80-CVS).

items.item: Clipping and division of duct and artery, number and type of clips
items.surgidoc: Not reported. The phase model knows a clipping phase, but no test fragment contains it and no model counts clips.

items.item: Dissection of the gallbladder from the liver bed, with the device used
items.surgidoc: Not in the test fragments; the phase model has a gallbladder dissection phase.
Reports when the L-hook electrocautery is in view, with times.

items.item: Retrieval of the gallbladder in a bag
items.surgidoc: Not in the test fragments; the phase model has a packaging phase.

items.item: Irrigation and haemostasis of the liver bed
items.surgidoc: Not in the test fragments; the phase model has a cleaning and coagulation phase.
Volume needs the suction record. SurgiDoc can only flag possible bleeding, with an unvalidated class, and says so in a limitation claim.
Possible bleeding events only, unvalidated; other complications (bile leak, injury) are not detected.

items.item: Trocar removal under vision, fascia and skin closure, dressing
items.surgidoc: Not reported. Trocar removal is visible from inside; the closure happens outside the camera view.

items.item: Tissue removed and sent to histology

items.item: Images or video of the key steps
items.surgidoc: Selects key frames with times and file paths, but chosen for coverage of the footage, not for the steps the template documents (CVS, clips).
